jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place.

Lightspeed is looking for a Technical Specialist, Strategic Accounts in Germany. You will be mostly focused on K-Series, report into the Strategic Support Services Team Lead and will be an important part of our global hospitality support organization.

Our Strategic Support Services team oversees the Lightspeed Strategic Accounts support experience. This group partners with Senior Support + Strategic Accounts Management to quarterback the service experience for our most valuable and complex merchants.

What the Role involves

-
Deliver Premium Support: Provide exceptional technical assistance and white-glove customer service to Strategic Accounts via email, phone, video, and on-site engagements.

-
Optimize Business Processes: Proactively identify opportunities to recommend best practices, helping high-value clients streamline operations and maximize the value of the Lightspeed ecosystem.

-
Facilitate Seamless Transitions: Partner with Implementation teams to execute successful "warm handoffs," ensuring a consistent and smooth experience for new Strategic accounts.

-
Strengthen Account Partnerships: Collaborate closely with Strategic Account Managers (SAMs) to manage daily operations, resolve complex issues, and elevate the overall customer journey.

-
Anticipate Client Needs: Lead unified customer meetings alongside SAMs to review ongoing requests, forecast future requirements, and mitigate risks before they escalate.

-
Drive Features Adoption: Conduct proactive account health syncs (remote or on-site) to advocate for feature adoption that translates into measurable business growth for the client.

-
Provide Training Sessions: Ensure our Strategic customers continue to fully utilise the potential of our software by providing training to new and existing staff members.

-
Influence Product Strategy: Synthesize deep insights into client business challenges to advocate for product enhancements, liaising directly with Product and Development teams to refine the user experience.

-
Escalation Management: Manage high-stakes technical escalations end-to-end—overseeing technical resolution, executive communication, and stakeholder feedback loops to ensure total customer satisfaction.

-
Advanced Troubleshooting: Employ a comprehensive suite of diagnostic techniques to rapidly isolate the root cause of escalated issues and deliver high-impact solutions.

-
Knowledge Management: Maintain meticulous documentation of account-specific complexities and resolutions to empower global Support teams and ensure consistent service delivery.

-
Champion Technical Excellence: Write and maintain troubleshooting guides, testing procedures, and internal documentation while precisely tracking software defects for corrective action.

-
Cross-Platform Mastery: Continually develop technical expertise across all Strategic Lightspeed hospitality platforms to provide versatile, high-level support.

And a little bit of....

-
Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

Your experience

There’s many different ways to gain “experience”. People learn in different ways, skill sets can be transferred, especially when combined with a willingness to learn. If you don’t quite tick all of these boxes but think you could still absolutely smash it, send us an application anyway and let us know why you’d be amazing in this role!

-
This role is open to candidates located in Berlin.

-
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English (we do service multiple languages, so any others you know are a bonus!).

-
Extensive customer service experience in a technical support role.

-
Prior experience in the Hospitality industry.

-
Ability to self-manage incoming emails, telephone calls, video calls, meetings, and on-site visits based on priority and customer commitments.

-
Strong computer skills and working knowledge of Mac OS.

-
Proven troubleshooting skills in a senior support position.

-
Strong problem-solving skills that will ensure our customers use their POS to its full capacity.

-
Ability to manage technical escalations of at-risk accounts and identify growth opportunities.

-
Flexibility in your schedule to work. Support never stops!

Even better if you have, but not necessary

-
Knowledge of networking or network support experience.

-
Understanding of API (relevant to SaaS) and experience supporting this.

-
Prior experience in a consultant role.

What’s in it for you

We're a global company, and our benefits vary depending on the country you live in. But here's a brief overview of our global benefits:

-
Equity options: We grant equity in the form of Restricted Share Units (RSUs) to our employees. Because this is your company, too.

-
Health & wellness credit: Our Health & Wellness credit can be used in numerous ways so that you feel at your best.

-
Career development: We're big on internal moves and new challenges across Lightspeed.

-
Time off to volunteer: Our volunteer program is a global initiative encouraging Lightspeeders to use one day off a year to give back to their communities.

-
Health apps: Access to professional or coaching services is available to all employees.

-
And many more, depending on the country you’re based in!

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... Hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

jobs.segment: AI Platform for Plaintiff Law Firms
jobs.summary: About Eve Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there.
jobs.description:
About Eve

Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

About the Role:

Intake is the highest-leverage moment in a plaintiff's firm's relationship with a client — cases get signed or lost here, often before anyone at the firm has opened a file. It's also one of the most technically demanding surfaces we build: every firm's AI voice agent, call scoring, transfer rules, and lead routing gets hand-tuned to that firm's practice areas and intake process, and as more firms come through the door, that build work only becomes more central to how fast and how well they succeed on Eve.

We're hiring a Legal AI Architect to own intake as its own discipline: the technical build, the integration work, and the relationship with every firm going through it, end to end. You'll partner with the CSM who owns the overall onboarding relationship and with integrations engineering on the phone system and CRM side — but the intake build itself, and the firm's experience of it, is yours to run.

Location and travel: Remote-based, with regular travel to client sites for on-site engagements. 50%+ required

What You'll Do:

- Own voice agent customization end to end for every firm in intake onboarding — the call flow (personality, firm knowledge base, objection handling, case-type-specific intake questions), transfer rules, staff directories, and call/lead scoring criteria, all tuned to how that firm actually runs intake.

- Set up the full intake stack alongside integrations engineering: phone system integrations (RingCentral and others), CRM/DMS handoff (Clio Grow, Lead Docket, Smart Advocate), and e-signature setup so a retainer can go out and get signed while the client is still on the phone.

- Set the standard for what "fully onboarded" looks like on intake — the checkpoints, the sequencing, the judgment calls — so every firm you touch lands in a good spot and stays there.

- Turn what you learn into training and documentation the rest of the team builds on, raising what every CSM and LAA can handle on their own over time.

- Carry a book of intake-focused accounts, including the intake-only and "land and expand" deals that are hard to place well because of how specialized this setup is. (Open question: does this book stay at standard scope, or flex down-market given how much more standardized intake-only setups are versus a full Eve implementation?)

What We're Looking For:

- You have a J.D., or you've held a legal operations role at a plaintiffs' firm of meaningful size.

- You understand intake — call flows, lead qualification, objection handling, and what actually makes a case viable — from real experience with it, whatever form that took.

- You can turn that operational knowledge into a technical build — comfortable configuring and iterating on AI-driven workflows, not just describing how intake should work.

- You document and systematize as you go, so what you know becomes the team's playbook, not just your own.

- You work well across functions — with CSMs who own the client relationship, with integrations engineering, and directly with firms.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Direct experience with legal intake or voice AI platforms (RingCentral, Clio Grow, Lead Docket, Smart Advocate, or similar).

- Consulting experience layered on top of legal or intake operations background.

- Experience training non-technical teams on a new workflow or tool.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Eve and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

$140,000—$170,000 USD

Benefits

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity
💹 401(k) Program with Employer Matching
⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability
🚗 Commuter Benefits*
🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment
🖥️ Workplace Setup Reimbursement
🏠 Telecomm Stipend
🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays
🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings
🥪 In office Perks*

*In office employees only

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to your recruiter.

Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Junior Office Manager
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Stiamo cercando un* Junior Office Manager pragmatic*, energic* e super organizzat*.

Cerchiamo una persona con una grande attitudine pratica, la voglia di imparare e l'entusiasmo di "sporcarsi le mani" ogni giorno per far funzionare la nostra sede come un orologio, sempre con il sorriso e la voglia di creare un ambiente accogliente.

Sarai il punto di riferimento operativo per la vita quotidiana del nostro ufficio. In questo ruolo c’è da rimboccarsi le maniche e gestire aspetti sia pratici che logistici:

-
Gestione operativa dell'ufficio: dalla manutenzione quotidiana al riordino degli spazi, dal monitoraggio delle forniture (cancelleria, snack, dotazioni) alla risoluzione dei piccoli e grandi imprevisti pratici di ogni giorno.

-
Interfaccia con fornitori e manutentori: sarai tu a coordinare gli interventi tecnici, i servizi di pulizia e la sicurezza, assicurandoti che tutto sia sempre efficiente e a norma.

-
Accoglienza e logistica: accoglierai ospiti, candidati e colleghi, gestirai la posta/corrieri e ti assicurerai che le sale riunioni e le postazioni siano sempre pronte ed equipaggiate.

-
Supporto al team e agli eventi: darai un aiuto concreto nell'organizzazione dei momenti di condivisione aziendali come il nostro Family Dinner del venerdì!

-
Proattività quotidiana: non aspetterai che siano gli altri a notare che qualcosa non va: ti anticipi, trovi soluzioni semplici e ti assicuri che l'ufficio sia un posto fantastico in cui lavorare.

-
Attitudine da “risolutore di problemi” e concretezza: non hai paura di metterti in gioco in prima persona, ti piace l'operatività e trovi soddisfazione nel risolvere i problemi sul campo in modo rapido e pratico.

-
Profilo Junior / Primi anni di esperienza: sei all'inizio della tua carriera o hai una breve esperienza in contesti operativi, di accoglienza, retail, hospitality o supporto organizzativo, ma soprattutto hai una gran voglia di imparare e crescere in un contesto veloce.

-
Energia e spirito di iniziativa: sei una persona dinamica, solare e positiva. Se c'è da spostare uno scatolone, riordinare una sala o gestire un'emergenza dell'ultimo minuto, sei il* prim* a dare una mano.

-
Precisione e doti organizzative: anche nel caos saprai prioritizzare le urgenze e tenere tutto sotto controllo senza perdere il filo.

-
Presenza e cura degli spazi: ami lavorare di persona a contatto con la gente. Questo è un ruolo 100% in presenza: l'ufficio è il tuo "regno" e ti piace prendertene cura in prima persona.

In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati.

Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

-
Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

-
Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

-
Sede: Roma

-
Ore: Tempo pieno

-
Presenza in ufficio: Si

jobs.title: Bilingual Client Retention Specialist
jobs.summary: At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future.
jobs.description:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

Our Customer Success Team serves as the primary point of contact for valued customers enrolled in Beyond Finance’s financial hardship programs. Our Retention Specialists play a critical role in ensuring the continued loyalty of our Beyond customer base. As a Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility will be to educate and assist clients who are facing financial hardship and exploring options to become debt-free. You will play a crucial role in retaining clients within our financial hardship debt program. In this position, you will interact with clients primarily through inbound phone calls and be responsible for deescalating upset clients, empathizing with their financial difficulties, and helping them navigate the program. Their primary focus is on our at-risk customers who are struggling with the use and/or value of their enrolled program, requiring creative problem solving to help them better realize and understand the value of their decision.

Key Responsibilities:

- Educate Clients: Provide comprehensive information about Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program to clients, ensuring they have a clear understanding of the benefits, process, and available options.

- Empathize and Deescalate: Display empathy and active listening skills to understand and deescalate upset clients, addressing their concerns and alleviating their stress regarding their financial situation.

- Navigate CRM System: Effectively use our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to quickly access and comprehend client information, including their current financial status and program progress. Maintain accurate and detailed records of all client interactions and program progress in the CRM system.

- Analyze Financial Situation: Assess the client's current financial situation and determine the most appropriate options to help them achieve their goal of becoming debt-free.

- Retain Clients: Collaborate with clients to develop customized solutions that align with their financial goals, and encourage them to remain in the Beyond Finance program.

- Achieve Retention Goals: Meet or exceed retention targets and earn commissions based on your ability to enable clients to achieve their financial objectives.

- Above all else, provide a best-in-class customer service experience over the phone and through various communication tools responding to client requests and anticipating unstated needs

What We Look For

- Bilingual Spanish Required

- Required - Experience in Retention, Sales, or Collections

- High school diploma or equivalent (Associate's or Bachelor's degree is a plus)

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle high call volumes

- Resilient and able to remain calm under pressure

- Demonstrated ability to negotiate and deescalate client issues effectively

- Tech saavy and proficiency with a Client Relationship Management system (CRM)

- Strong customer focus and adaptability to different personality types

- Strong verbal and written communication skills along with active listening

- Supports team/department collaboration & inclusion

- Troubleshooting and problem solving skills

- Ability to multi-task, set priorities and manage time effectively

- Willingness to adapt to a changing environment and learn about new financial solutions.

#LI-ST1

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position. The actual base salary offered will depend on numerous factors including the individual’s skills, experience, performance, and the location where work is performed.

Base Pay Range

$19—$21 USD

Why Join Us?

While you make a difference for others, we’ll work to make a difference for you, providing an uplifting, collaborative work environment and benefits that reflect your value to us. For eligible full-time employees, we offer:

- Considerable employer contributions for health, dental, and vision programs

- Generous PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave

- 401(k) matching program

- Merit advancement opportunities

- Career development & training

And finally, our team spirit and culture! We cultivate an environment of community, connection, and belonging across our entire organization.

Beyond Finance does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job positions. No fee will be paid to their parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to Beyond Finance employees or the Beyond Finance HR team. No placement fee will be paid to any third party unless such a request has been made by the Beyond HR team.

jobs.description:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

Our Customer Service Representatives (CSR) serve as the primary point of contact for clients enrolled in Beyond Finance’s financial hardship programs. They are Beyond’s voice to the client and provide the connection between our Sales and Operations teams. Our CSRs possess a “second-to-none” work ethic and an upbeat, positive and passionate attitude about customer service. By responding promptly to client requests, and possessing an acute awareness that allows them to anticipate the client’s needs and exceed expectations, our Client Success Department is critical to the success of helping maintain Beyond’s exemplary customer brand.

As a Customer Service Representative, you will complete a 4 week training program to become an expert in Beyond's financial hardship programs. After you successfully complete training, you will be responsible for providing superior customer service and a positive experience to our clients. The Client Success Representative role is a remote position.

Our call center is open 7 days a week. The hours are M-F 7:00am-10:00pm CST and Sat/Sun 7:00am-9:00pm CST.

What You’ll Do

- Above all else, provide a best-in-class customer service experience over the phone by responding to client requests, anticipating unstated needs, and educating them on our programs

- Through demonstrated effective listening, analyze client problems and provide information and solutions in a timely and efficient manner

- Employs strong interpersonal skills to handle difficult calls courteously and professionally

- Thoroughly documents request outcomes for accurate tracking and analysis

- Work efficiently and effectively to independently resolve client requests, both as a team and independently

- Develops and maintains positive client relations and coordinates with other departments within the company to ensure client requests and questions are handled appropriately and in a timely manner

- Operates a desktop computer to obtain and extract information; documents information, activities and changes in the CRM database (Client Relationship Management System) for client accounts

- Utilizes appropriate resource materials to effectively and accurately interpret‚ respond and resolve client inquiries and problems

- Handle a high volume of clients in a work from home call center environment

What We Look For

- 1 year call center experience (Required)

- Bilingual - Spanish (Required)

- Reliable, High Speed, Internet connection (Required)

- Technical proficiency with Client Relationship Management system (CRM)

- Strong customer service orientation

- Strong communicator: Includes listening, verbal & written communication, courteous and professional active listening skills is a must

- Effective problem solver

- Effective at time management, planning & organizing tasks and time

- Ability to understand and empathize with customer issue(s)

- Ability to work from home in a distraction free environment

#LI-NA1

Why Join Us?

While you make a difference for others, we’ll work to make a difference for you, providing an uplifting, collaborative work environment and benefits that reflect your value to us. For eligible full-time employees, we offer:

- Considerable employer contributions for health, dental, and vision programs

- Generous PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave

- 401(k) matching program

- Merit advancement opportunities

- Career development & training

And finally, our team spirit and culture! We cultivate an environment of community, connection, and belonging across our entire organization.

Beyond Finance does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job positions. No fee will be paid to their parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to Beyond Finance employees or the Beyond Finance HR team. No placement fee will be paid to any third party unless such a request has been made by the Beyond HR team.

jobs.description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality. 
Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.
We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.

About the role:
We are looking for an Energy Markets Specialist to provide senior commercial and market expertise across OEGEN’s renewable portfolio. The role will have particular responsibility for overseeing energy-market activity for a key fund and more broadly building OEGEN’s strategic BESS capability.
Working across Asset Management, Fund Management, Investment and Technical teams, the successful candidate will translate increasingly complex energy markets into clear commercial recommendations. This will include supporting investment decisions, optimising operational assets and developing consistent approaches to BESS revenue strategy, route-to-market, hedging and market risk.
This is a highly commercial and execution-focused role. Time will be split across fund and asset support, strategic market development, complex commercial processes and challenging market assumptions. The successful candidate will be expected to use external partners where appropriate, while retaining clear ownership of the commercial question, analysis and recommendation.

-
Lead energy-market coverage for ORIT, including route-to-market performance, revenue strategy, hedging, market risk and key commercial counterparties

-
Build OEGEN’s BESS commercial strategy across priority markets, including revenue underwriting, route-to-market, optimiser selection and risk management

-
Provide senior market input into investment decisions, challenging assumptions on power prices, capture prices, ancillary services, balancing, negative pricing, grid constraints and commercial structures

-
Develop clear standards and guidance for BESS and collocated assets, ensuring lessons from operational assets are reflected in new investment assumptions

-
Lead or oversee complex commercial processes, including optimiser, route-to-market and strategic PPA tenders; work with external providers to deliver routine contracting efficiently where appropriate

-
Monitor energy-market, regulatory and policy developments across OEGEN’s priority markets, identifying risks and opportunities for funds and assets

-
Work closely with Fund Asset Directors and Fund Management teams to develop and implement market strategies that support fund objectives, investor returns and risk appetite

-
Manage relationships with traders, optimisers, balancing parties, advisers and other key commercial partners, holding them to account for performance

-
Define and interpret quantitative analysis required for hedging, BESS, merchant exposure and portfolio risk, working with specialist analytical support where appropriate

-
Communicate complex market issues clearly to Investment Committee, Asset Boards and investors, with practical recommendations and a clear view of risk

-
Significant experience in European power markets, renewable energy commercialisation, trading, optimisation or energy-market advisory

-
Strong practical experience of BESS commercial strategy, including revenue modelling, route-to-market arrangements, ancillary services, dispatch considerations and optimiser performance

-
Experience working for, or advising, a renewable IPP, fund manager, utility, trading house, optimiser or energy-market consultancy

-
Excellent commercial judgement, with a track record of challenging and improving market assumptions, commercial structures or route-to-market strategies

-
Strong understanding of renewable revenue drivers, including PPAs, merchant exposure, hedging, balancing, capture price, negative pricing, ancillary services and grid constraints

-
High financial and numerical acumen, with the ability to build, review and challenge complex revenue models and investment assumptions

-
Experience leading complex commercial processes and managing external counterparties, including PPA, route-to-market, optimiser or trading arrangements

-
Ability to work credibly with investment, technical, fund-management and asset-management teams, translating market complexity into clear decisions

-
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present commercial recommendations to senior management, Investment Committee and investors

jobs.description:
About the Team

Transaction Risk Enablement is the shared services function supporting Mercury's Fraud, Disputes, and Risk UX programs. We build the knowledge base articles, SOPs, and eLearning that frontline teams rely on to do their jobs accurately and consistently — and that hold up to regulatory scrutiny in a financial services environment. This is a small, high-output team doing work that directly shapes how well-documented and audit-ready Mercury's risk operations are.

Role Summary

We're looking for a L&D Specialist to join a growing team supporting Fraud, Disputes, and Risk UX. You'll write and maintain formal SOPs, Guru knowledge base articles, and Articulate-built eLearning — translating operational processes and regulatory requirements into content that's clear, accurate, and usable by the teams who rely on it every day. You'll work primarily within one or two of these domains, going deep on the processes and regulatory context that matter most there, while collaborating with Specialists and SMEs across the broader team.

This is an experienced-contributor role: you'll own content projects from scoping through publication with minimal oversight, exercise sound judgment in ambiguous or incomplete-information situations, and be looked to as a source of regulatory and process knowledge others build on. You're not just executing a content backlog — you're expected to spot where standards or resources need to improve and drive those improvements yourself.

This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys both the craft of instructional design and the discipline of regulatory-grade technical writing — and who wants ownership over content that has real operational weight, not just training that gets built once and forgotten.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What You'll Do

- Own SOP, knowledge base, and eLearning projects end to end — from initial scoping and SME discovery through drafting, review, sign-off, and publishing — with minimal day-to-day direction

- Author and maintain formal SOPs following Mercury's standard template — version control, regulatory citations, sign-off workflow, and publishing to PDF

- Write and update Guru knowledge base articles as operational job aids for frontline teams

In this strategic engagement, you will perform comprehensive gap analyses, assess existing security controls, design robust compliance workflows, and drive cross-functional teams toward audit completion.

Utilizing automated compliance platforms such as Sprinto, you will build repeatable compliance processes, validate technical controls, and ensure a seamless audit experience across the entire organization.

Our client is a fast-scaling, cloud-native technology platform committed to maintaining enterprise-grade trust, security, and data privacy. To support their rapid commercial growth and enterprise sales pipeline, they are establishing a formal, highly disciplined security governance model.

By leveraging modern GRC platforms and fostering a security-conscious culture, they provide an empowering environment for compliance experts to drive real architectural and procedural improvements.

SOC 2 Readiness & Gap Analysis: Conduct a thorough assessment of existing technical and operational security controls, pinpointing compliance gaps and building an actionable remediation roadmap.
Control Design & Implementation: Author, refine, and operationalize security controls, policies, and procedures aligned with SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (TSC) and PCI DSS standards.
Automated Evidence Collection: Lead evidence-gathering workflows using automated GRC tooling (Sprinto), ensuring all technical artifacts, access logs, and policy attestations are validated and audit-ready.
PCI DSS Guidance: Provide expert advisory on maintaining PCI DSS alignment alongside SOC 2, ensuring overlapping control requirements are mapped efficiently to reduce operational drag.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, HR, and IT teams to embed compliance workflows into daily operations without slowing down feature execution.
Auditor Interface & Readiness: Serve as the primary liaison during the audit preparation phase, coordinating directly with external auditors to present evidence, resolve findings, and ensure a successful audit cycle.

SOC 2 Mastery: Proven track record of leading end-to-end SOC 2 readiness, gap remediation, and audit preparation initiatives for cloud-native or B2B SaaS companies.
GRC & PCI DSS Acumen: Deep familiarity with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) frameworks, risk assessment methodologies, and PCI DSS compliance requirements.
Tooling Proficiency (Sprinto): Direct, practical experience leveraging automated compliance and evidence-collection platforms, specifically Sprinto (or equivalent modern platforms like Vanta/Drata).

Headquarters: Oxford, UK

URL: https://getellipsis.com

Description

Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies. This is a high-impact, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The transition to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative/strategic in our approach, we started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, and thus this has been a time for us to thrive.

Today, we think we have a better understanding of AI search than almost anyone else. We have both the tracking product (built in-house), the data (~25 million AI answers for analysis, with more tracked weekly), and the execution end-to-end from strategy, to writing, to in-house design, to optimisation, and performance reporting.

We're looking for an Executive Assistant to help our Founder and Managing Director, Alex, and our Chief of Staff, Anna, make the best possible use of their time, while ensuring important work across the business is prepared, coordinated and followed through. You'll provide day-to-day EA support to Alex and work closely with Anna on wider business matters.

You will be the metronome that helps the business keep moving. Your work will be extremely high-impact, and you’ll be involved at a high level across the business. This is not a general operations role: your focus is excellent executive support, careful coordination and practical follow-through.

This position can be broken down as follows:

60% support to Alex.

40% support to Anna on wider business priorities, including finance and people administration.

Remote work requires trust, and in this role this will be absolutely critical. Trust is built over time, and accordingly your responsibilities will grow over time. Our hope is that you will prove indispensable to the business, but we understand it will take months to get to this place. Thus, below is a list of some of the responsibilities you’ll be able to grow into over time.

Support to Alex

Your most important responsibility is helping Alex maximise his time, protect his attention, reduce unnecessary context-switching, and stay focused on the work where he adds the most value.

- Calendar management: Own and manage Alex’s diary and calendar. Protect focused work and create space for strategic priorities. Make sensible scheduling decisions using your knowledge of Alex’s priorities, resolve clashes proactively, and account for preparation, travel time, location, time zones and the purpose of each meeting. Challenge or reorganise meetings where there is a better use of Alex’s time, and make sure Alex has the right preparation and information before important meetings.

- Inbox and communication: Assist the Managing Director with maintaining an organised and efficient inbox, including drafting replies or responding directly on his behalf at times. Effectively triage emails, understand possible courses of action, and present information to Alex in a way that lets him quickly provide a batch of responses that unblock you. Chase outstanding replies, actions and commitments, and build templates and systems for recurring email patterns so that important messages and obligations do not disappear.

- Briefings: Prepare a clear, concise morning briefing for Alex at the start of each day before he logs on (8.30am uk), giving him an overview of his schedule, priorities, deadlines, outstanding decisions and follow-up. Monitor his relevant communication channels, use judgement to identify what needs his attention, and make sure he is reminded of important to-dos, commitments and preparation ahead of time. These briefings are sometimes also required in the afternoon.

- Day-to-day tasks: The remit of this role is not “follow this clearly defined process every time”, but “take this mostly finished project and figure out how to proactively take it to completion”. These tasks might touch project management, writing/editing, triaging information, posting on LinkedIn, research, drafting communications and ensuring action is taken. You’ll need to work out the information, stakeholders, decisions and follow-up required, rather than waiting for every task to arrive as a fully documented process.

- Meetings: Prepare for meetings, including ensuring slides, agendas and internal notes are prepared. Your goal is to ensure we utilise meeting time most effectively and are able to put our best foot forward. Use approved AI tools to capture and summarise meetings where appropriate, then check the output for accuracy and missing nuance. Extract decisions, actions, owners and deadlines; create follow-up tasks and communications; and make sure agreed actions are completed. This is about excellent preparation and follow-through, rather than traditional minute-taking as an end in itself.

- Travel: Coordinate complex travel for Alex. Prepare clear itineraries and manage flights, hotels, transport, meetings, dinners and contingencies.

- Occasional personal administration: This is a business-focused role and the overwhelming responsibility is with the business. You may be occasionally asked to take care of personal admin for Alex where this meaningfully protects his time.

Support to Anna and the wider business

You will report directly to Anna. Outside of supporting Alex, your role is to help her deliver wider team and business priorities.

- Finance administration: This is an important part of the role. Support Anna with Ellipsis's day-to-day finance administration. This includes filing expenses, collecting invoices and receipts, preparing client invoices for review, gathering freelancer and supplier invoices, preparing payment information for approval, and chasing late client payments. You'll keep records accurate and tidy, help manage the finance inbox, and flag discrepancies promptly. Anna and our accountants remain responsible for payroll, pensions, compliance and all accounting decisions - your role is to make sure the inputs are complete, accurate and on time.

Requirements: hard skills

- Meticulous attention to detail

- Experience working remotely full time

- Availability to work 8am - 5pm UK time (or earlier)

- Fantastic communication skills: Remote work relies on mutual trust, so frequent and clear written communication is essential

Your capability matters a lot more to us than your experience, and we would recommend you tailor your application with this in mind. We want to hear from you rather than ChatGPT. Please keep this in mind in particular with the screening questions.

Benefits

- Support for your growth, whether that’s upskilling, training, or exploring the direction you want to develop in

The application process

It's important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this.

Much of our company wiki is externally accessible, and you're encouraged to read through this before applying. We have a very useful guide to our interview process available here. This tells you what we're looking for and reading this will significantly increase your chance of success!

Following the completion of trial projects, we'll ask for professional references from your previous 2 managers. We ask candidates to introduce us to their references, for a 10 minute call.

We do great work for clients and are building an ethical business that lets everyone do their best work. If you think you could be the next person to join our team, please apply :)

Headquarters: Big Bear Lake, California, USA

URL: https://www.bigbearvacations.com/

OWNER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST

Department: Owner Relations / Owner Experience
Market: Puerto Vallarta & Nuevo Vallarta, Mexico
Reports To: Director of Owner Relations
Employment Type: Contractor
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Monday - Saturday
Compensation: USD $1,200 monthly
Languages: Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken — required

Position Purpose

The Owner Experience Specialist is the primary point of contact between Naya Homes and our homeowners in Puerto Vallarta and Nuevo Vallarta.

This role is responsible for building and maintaining strong, consistent, and proactive relationships with homeowners in order to support owner satisfaction and retention. Rather than simply reacting to problems after they occur, the Specialist is expected to identify potential concerns early and address them before they become reasons for an owner to consider terminating their relationship with Naya Homes.

The Specialist owns three key outcomes: executing the required owner communication cadence under the 33-Touch Relationship Model; providing homeowners with clear visibility into the condition and performance of their properties; and capturing property content that supports marketing efforts, social media, and owner communication.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, proactive, customer-focused, and comfortable managing a high volume of daily communication while maintaining accurate documentation and consistent follow-up.

Fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken, is an indispensable requirement for this position. The Specialist will communicate with homeowners and internal teams in both languages.

Because this is a remote contractor position, the primary focus is on achieving established goals, service standards, and KPIs. The schedule may be flexible as needed to ensure objectives are met, while maintaining the required availability and responsiveness for homeowners and the business.

Core Responsibilities

1. Owner Relationship Management & Communication

-
Execute 20–25 documented owner interactions per day through calls, email, and text.

-
Maintain 100% completion of required monthly touches for every assigned owner under the 33-Touch Relationship Model.

-
Maintain a balance across the three touch types:

-
Property Visibility: condition updates, inspection findings, photos, and property content.

-
Personal Relationship: relationship-building communication not directly related to a transaction or problem.

-
Informative / Value-Driven: performance, pricing, market conditions, and seasonal outlook.

-
Enter every interaction with a clear purpose and conclude it with a defined next step.

-
Complete scheduled owner check-in calls on the day they are due and rebook any rescheduled calls before the end of the same business day.

-
Maintain clear communication regarding availability, support, and expected response times so owners always know who to contact and when they can expect an answer.

-
Build trust and maintain professional, long-term relationships with homeowners.

2. Property Visibility & Owner Updates

-
Collect property updates from Operations, Housekeeping, Maintenance, and inspection reports.

-
Review condition notes and available photos before communicating with owners to ensure updates are specific and accurate.

-
Translate operational findings into clear, plain-language owner updates, including what was found, what action is being taken, associated costs, and expected resolution timelines.

-
Respond to all open owner conversations regarding work orders.

-
Ensure that no work order is dispatched to an owner's property without documented owner approval.

-
Ensure that every unresolved property issue has a clearly assigned next action and responsible person.

-
Provide owners with meaningful visibility into the work being performed on their property.

3. Escalation & Churn Risk Identification

-
Identify early signs of owner dissatisfaction or potential churn, including declining sentiment, slow or short responses, revenue complaints, recurring property condition issues, questions regarding contract terms, or references to other management companies.

-
Escalate concerns on the same business day.

-
Add applicable owners to the Owner Churn Board and keep records current as situations develop.

-
Confirm ownership of the next action for every escalation and ensure each open case has a clearly assigned responsible person.

-
Communicate potential risks early rather than waiting for issues to escalate.

4. Documentation & CRM Discipline

-
Log every owner interaction in Monday.com on the same day it occurs.

-
Maintain the Owner Churn Board on a daily basis.

-
Schedule all future owner touches and follow-ups before closing out the day.

-
Prepare a clear next-day action list before logging off.

-
Complete a weekly CRM documentation self-audit and correct any gaps identified.

-
Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records of all owner communications.

Daily Operating Rhythm

Start of Day

-
Log into RingCentral and Monday.com.

-
Review the Owner Engagement Tracker.

-
Identify owners due for required touches.

-
Review notes from inspections, maintenance, turnovers, and operations.

-
Flag owners with open concerns, negative or declining sentiment, or recent performance or condition issues.

During the Day

-
Complete scheduled owner check-in calls.

-
Send required emails and text messages.

-
Complete scheduled property-content activities remotely or through available internal resources.

-
Collect and communicate relevant property updates.

-
Respond to open work order conversations.

-
Escalate concerns on the same business day.

-
Maintain consistent follow-up with assigned homeowners.

End of Day

-
Ensure all owner interactions are documented in Monday.com.

-
Update the Owner Churn Board.

-
Schedule future touches and follow-ups.

-
Confirm that there are zero undocumented conversations.

-
Prepare the next-day action list.

Weekly Close

-
Maintain 100% progress toward required monthly owner touches.

-
Ensure there are no missed follow-ups.

-
Complete the CRM documentation self-audit.

-
Review owner sentiment trends.

-
Identify unresolved owner issues requiring attention.

-
Identify owners requiring proactive outreach during the following week.

Performance Standards & KPIs

Performance will be measured monthly against the following targets:

-
Daily owner touches: 20–25 per day.

-
Required monthly touch completion: 100%.

-
Documentation accuracy: 95% or higher.

-
Undocumented conversations: Zero.

-
Same-day escalation compliance: 100%.

-
Overdue escalations beyond SLA: Zero.

-
Owner sentiment trend: Stable or improving.

-
Overall KPI attainment: 90% or higher.

-
Retention saves: Tracked and reviewed through the Owner Churn Board.

Sustained performance below the established targets may result in a documented coaching plan.

Accountability Standards

-
Missed follow-ups are considered a performance issue.

-
Undocumented conversations are considered a performance issue.

-
Dispatching a work order without documented owner approval is considered a performance issue.

-
Early escalation is considered a positive behavior and is recognized accordingly.

-
Proactive communication is an expectation of the role, not an additional benefit or optional activity.

-
The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned conversations, follow-ups, and open issues through resolution or appropriate escalation.

Qualifications

Required

-
Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken — indispensable.

-
2+ years of experience in client-facing account management, hospitality, property management, customer success, or a related field.

-
Demonstrated experience working independently and managing responsibilities in a remote environment.

-
Strong CRM discipline and a proven track record of documenting work consistently without requiring constant follow-up.

-
Comfortable initiating a high volume of outbound calls and handling difficult conversations directly and professionally.

-
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.

-
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with clients and maintain long-term relationships.

-
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and priorities simultaneously.

-
Proactive approach to identifying potential dissatisfaction and escalating concerns appropriately.

-
Ability to shoot and edit short-form vertical video using a phone and tools such as CapCut, Instagram, or equivalent.

-
Strong computer skills and ability to work independently with digital communication, CRM, and collaboration tools.

-
Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-office environment for remote work.

Preferred

-
Previous experience in short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, or property management.

-
Working knowledge of Streamline VRS, Monday.com, or comparable PMS/CRM platforms.

-
Experience producing content for Instagram, TikTok, Airbnb, or other property marketing platforms.

-
Understanding of owner statements, management fees, and short-term rental revenue basics.

-
Familiarity with the Puerto Vallarta / Nuevo Vallarta vacation rental market.

Key Attributes

The ideal candidate will be:

-
Reliable and consistent: Able to perform repetitive activities consistently and accurately.

-
Calm and professional: Comfortable dealing with frustrated homeowners without becoming defensive or over-promising.

-
Highly organized: Capable of managing 20–25 daily conversations while maintaining complete follow-up.

-
Proactive: Identifies potential issues early and takes action before they escalate.

-
Accountable: Communicates problems honestly and takes ownership of mistakes.

-
Relationship-oriented: Genuinely interested in understanding homeowners, their properties, and their needs.

-
Adaptable: Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and managing priorities without constant supervision.

-
Strong communicator: Able to communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish.

First 90 Days

Days 1–30

-
Complete access and onboarding for Monday.com, Streamline, RingCentral, and the Owner Engagement Tracker.

-
Become confident using the required systems and communication tools.

-
Review the assigned owner portfolio.

-
Make introductory contact with assigned homeowners.

-
Complete shadowing and initial training.

Days 31–60

-
Execute the full daily communication volume of 20–25 owner touches.

-
Maintain 100% documentation compliance.

-
Demonstrate consistent follow-up and proactive communication.

-
Begin independently identifying and escalating owner concerns.

Days 61–90

-
Achieve overall KPI attainment of 90% or higher.

-
Own at least one owner retention case from identification through resolution or successful escalation.

-
Demonstrate consistent owner relationship management and CRM discipline.

-
Contribute repeatable content formats or communication practices that can be adopted by other Specialists.

This job description outlines the primary duties and standards of the role and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties may be adjusted according to business needs. Workload structure, escalation pathways, and coaching practices will be administered in accordance with applicable company policies and requirements.

Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.

1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
simplifier et améliorer nos process

-
construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

-
construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

-
automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

-
identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

-
participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

-
accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

-
l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

-
la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

-
le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

-
les questions des managers et des salarié·es

-
le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

-
le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

-
tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

-
tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

-
tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

-
tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel et, plus largement, avec un environnement de travail digital : Google Workspace, Slack, MacBook…

-
tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

-
tu es autonome, à l’aise dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et capable de prioriser entre projets de fond et sujets opérationnels plus urgents

Pour être transparent, ce poste ne correspondra probablement pas à quelqu’un qui cherche :

-
un poste de Data Analyst / People Analyst pur

-
un rôle uniquement centré sur les projets, sans envie de contribuer au run

-
un poste principalement orienté paie ou administration du personnel

-
un poste purement tech

-
un rôle très stratégique ou de management, éloigné du quotidien des opérations

Nous cherchons quelqu’un de polyvalent et solide en People Ops, qui peut aussi bien passer une matinée à faire avancer un projet outil ou data qu’une après-midi à aider l’équipe sur de la paie, une incohérence de données ou une question manager.

jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
In Octopus Energy crediamo che le strutture burocratiche tradizionali rischino spesso di infantilizzare le persone e soffocare la creatività. Le persone adulte non hanno bisogno di rigide regole dall'alto, ma di autonomia, responsabilità e fiducia.
Non cerchiamo un HR tradizionale che imponga processi o "gestisca" le persone per conto dei manager. Cerchiamo una figura di People Operations capace di costruire strumenti e percorsi fluidi (come il nostro onboarding automatizzato) per rimuovere gli ostacoli e dare a ogni team il supporto per esprimersi al meglio fin dal primo giorno.

Gestione Contratti e Onboarding: Redazione e invio dei contratti di lavoro ai nuovi assunti, monitorando con cura lo stato di avanzamento della documentazione necessaria all’ingresso in azienda.

Supporto ai Team Leader: Gestione operativa delle richieste quotidiane, delle segnalazioni e degli aggiornamenti provenienti dai Team Leader.

Anagrafiche e Gestione Sistemi: Mantenimento e aggiornamento costante dei profili dei colleghi sui nostri sistemi gestionali (cambi di ruolo, variazioni contrattuali).

Miglioramento dei Processi & Automazioni: Contributo attivo all’ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro, alla creazione/manutenzione di template operativi e all'implementazione di automazioni.

Riservatezza e Cura dei Dati: Garanzia che ogni processo amministrativo e informativo sia gestito con massima cura, precisione e rispetto della riservatezza.

Progetti Amministrativi e Supporto Trasversale: Supporto operativo a progetti speciali o ad altre attività amministrative in base alle esigenze del team.

Ottime capacità comunicative: ottima proprietà di linguaggio sia scritta che orale, fondamentale per interagire con trasparenza con colleghi e stakeholder.

Organizzazione e dettaglio: spiccata attenzione ai dettagli, precisione impeccabile e capacità di organizzare le proprie priorità in modo autonomo.

Serietà e riservatezza: Elevata sensibilità nella gestione di informazioni riservate e dati personali.

Attitudine digitale: familiarità con strumenti digitali, software di gestione del personale o tool di produttività, unita alla capacità di imparare velocemente nuovi sistemi.

Spirito di squadra e proattività: attitudine collaborativa, capacità di anticipare i bisogni e orientamento pratico alla risoluzione dei problemi.

Flessibilità in ambienti dinamici: abilità nel muoversi con disinvoltura in un contesto in rapida crescita, flessibile e privo di burocrazia inutile.

Conoscenza di base di sistemi o procedure paghe (rappresenta un vantaggio apprezzato).

In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati.Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.
Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.
