jobs.title: Temporary US Corporate Relations Specialist
jobs.summary: Headquarters: United States URL: https://thehumaneleague.org/ WHO WE ARE The Humane League (THL) is a global nonprofit ending the abuse of animals raised for food.
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://thehumaneleague.org/

WHO WE ARE

The Humane League (THL) is a global nonprofit ending the abuse of animals raised for food. THL fosters a high-energy culture of teamwork and mission-driven problem solving, and we have earned recognition as Top Charity from Animal Charity Evaluators for all of their rating periods. Over the past few years, we’ve grown to a staff of 100+ talented individuals dispersed around the world. At THL, how animals are treated in the food system is at the forefront of our everyday work. We welcome all mission-aligned candidates to apply, no matter where you are in your journey to end the abuse of animals raised for food.

YOUR OPPORTUNITY

As the Temporary Corporate Relations Specialist, you will play an important role in supporting The Humane League’s efforts to engage with corporations and advance protections for animals in the food supply chain. You are motivated to make a difference in the lives of animals and have the passion to encourage corporate decision makers to do the same.

Your primary goal is to support and conduct outreach to bring issues of animal welfare to key decision makers at food companies and their business affiliates. Through research, data-management, and outreach, you will contribute to building relationships and advancing corporate commitments and policies on animal welfare. You will support outreach efforts that increase the number of companies engaged and contribute to measurable progress against corporate commitments, including organizational goals tied to company policy advancement.

In this role, you will work closely with the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US to support and lead corporate outreach plans, maintain accurate and up-to-date records of engagement, and share insights with the broader team to inform ongoing work while continuing to develop your knowledge of the food industry and corporate engagement strategies.

You are a self-driven communicator who can effectively deliver messages in a professional corporate environment. You are comfortable managing your day-to-day responsibilities independently while seeking guidance on more complex situations and collaborating closely with your team. This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys research, relationship-building, persuasive communication and continuous learning while developing experience in corporate engagement, negotiation support, and advocacy work.

This position reports directly to the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US. This is a temporary full-time, remote position lasting one-year (12 months) in duration, with the possibility of transitioning to a permanent role at The Humane League’s discretion. This role is based in the United States or Canada. To the extent permitted by law, in order to enable collaboration with other global team members, you may be required to work occasional hours outside of 9am - 5pm, depending on your time zone. This position requires domestic and international travel, equivalent to 2 or more trips per year lasting 2 - 4 nights in duration.

We will be recording a webinar hosted by Liz Fergus, Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US, Aimee Drugan, Sr. US Corporate Relations Lead, and Debbie Malenke, Sr. Corporate Relations Lead. The webinar recording will be available to watch here by August 13th.

Please submit your application by Friday, August 21 at 11:59 p.m. EST. We encourage early applications and will continue accepting submissions while the role is posted on our website. After this date, we will begin advancing candidates and may close the posting early or extend the deadline as needed. If you are experiencing technical issues, please contact careers@thehumaneleague.org. Please submit applications and all supporting documents in English. All application questions and materials need to be submitted here through the application submission form; we do not accept applications through our careers email.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

-
Execute outreach to decision makers at food companies through email, written materials, phone calls, virtual meetings, and occasional in-person engagement.

-
Support communication of proposed animal welfare measures and contribute to ongoing relationship management with corporate contacts to encourage policy adoption and progress toward existing commitments.

-
Participate in meetings and negotiations with corporate representatives, documenting outcomes and tracking progress toward animal welfare commitments while escalating complex issues to the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US as appropriate.

-
Conduct research to identify and verify information on food companies, industry trends, and corporate structures, including hard-to-find information, while evaluating source credibility.

-
Maintain and update CRM systems with accurate, timely data on outreach activities, contacts, and company progress, and share relevant industry insights with the broader team to inform engagement efforts.

-
Execute on outreach plans and schedules developed in collaboration with team leadership, managing multiple outreach streams and competing deadlines, and adapting priorities as business needs evolve.

-
Support outreach efforts tied to public reports and broader corporate engagement campaigns.

-
Collaborate with colleagues across teams and coordinate with external coalition partners to support campaign priorities, share research and contribute to coordinated corporate engagement efforts.

-
Develop a working knowledge of the food industry landscape, including key players, corporate decision-making structures, and relevant animal welfare policies and issues.

-
Utilize digital tools and platforms such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, Asana, and other software to manage outreach activities and maintain organized data.

-
Develop proficiency in research, outreach, and internal systems with support from team leadership during the onboarding and ramp period.

In addition to the above essential job duties, other duties may be assigned as business needs arise. These may include non-essential, marginal job duties.

REQUIRED SKILLS

-
Experience: 2+ years of professional or non-professional experience in corporate relations, the food industry, corporate sustainability, ESG, animal science, communications, economics, farm animal advocacy, law or policy, negotiations, research, sales, or other related fields involving relationship management and persuasive communication.

-
Execution, Ownership, and Problem Solving: Demonstrates the ability to manage assigned work independently with minimal supervision while following established processes. Applies sound judgment to resolve routine challenges, identifies opportunities for improvements, and seeks guidance on more complex issues as needed.

-
Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to confidently represent THL through emails, presentations, phone calls, and meetings with corporate stakeholders. Builds and maintains productive relationships through professionalism, diplomacy, active listening, and persuasive communication.

-
Resilience and Adaptability: Comfortable engaging in challenging conversations and receiving feedback. Demonstrates persistence when outreach efforts do not immediately result in engagement, maintains professionalism through rejection, and adapts approaches based on feedback or changing priorities.

-
Technology and Data Management: Experience using Google Workspace and Asana, or similar platforms. Ability to quickly learn Salesforce and maintain accurate, detailed records. Comfortable learning new technologies, including AI-enabled productivity tools, to improve efficiency while maintaining data quality.

-
Organization and Time Management: Effectively prioritizes and manages multiple responsibilities and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Maintains organized systems for tracking outreach, data, and communications.

-
Research and Strategic Thinking: Demonstrates strong research and critical thinking skills, including the ability to locate credible hard-to-find information, evaluate sources, synthesize findings, keep up with changes in the food industry, and use research to support the strategic decisions of the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US. Understanding of organizational strategy and policies, with the ability to recognize how individual tasks contribute to broader team and organizational goals.

-
Global Perspective: Approaches work with an understanding of the global nature of the organization’s programs. Demonstrated awareness of global factors and their relevance to specific projects and responsibilities.

-
Financial Acumen: Supports routine budget-related tasks such as tracking expenses and maintaining accurate records.

Hiring Timeline Details

Once your application has been reviewed, you will be notified via email with further details on the status of your application. If a candidate is moved forward, the interview process will be as follows:

-
Work Simulation Exercise (completed remotely)

-
Interview (via video call)

For full details of our recruitment process please review this document.

Compensation and Benefits

 The annual compensation range for this role is:

- $63,166 - $77,203 for candidates in based in the United States.

- $63,738 - $77,662 for candidates based in Canada

At The Humane League, we believe in maintaining a fair and nondiscriminatory work environment. As part of our commitment to transparency, we have implemented a job architecture framework, which levels all of our roles according to size and complexity, as well as a compensation step system, which allows us to determine fair salaries for all. We also look at market data for each country that we operate in, to allow us to create specific salary bands per country. This work is time consuming and involves a cost to THL. Therefore, when expanding into a country for the first time, we only undertake this work towards the end of the recruitment process, when we know where our ideal candidate is based. In addition, we have adopted a no negotiation policy for salaries. To determine a job's level, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including a job's size and complexity, required experience, knowledge, and/or skills, internal comparability, and market data. Candidates whose experience places them at step 5 or above of their job level within our compensation structure will be awarded a “Senior” title designation. These practices are aligned with our organizational values and will help us ensure we maintain clear, consistent, and transparent HR processes.

THL offers a unique and competitive benefits package. Each country will be provided with benefits that are applicable and relative to the location they are in. Therefore, your exact benefits package will be shared with you at the time of offer. However, as an idea, some of the benefits that are currently offered to our global team are:

- Unlimited paid time off

- The last Friday of every month off as a THL ‘Public Holiday’ called ‘Mend Your Heart Friday’

- Enhanced sick pay

- Generous bereavement leave

- Generous personal emergency leave

- Sabbatical leave

- Enhanced parental leave

- Health insurance

- Life insurance

- Retirement contributions

- Internet allowance

For candidates outside the United States, The Humane League will not be your direct employer. The successful candidate will enter an employment agreement with a local Employer of Record with whom The Humane League partners.

THL does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected classifications, including but not limited to race, color, age, national origin, ethnicity, religious creed or belief, physical or mental disability, marital or familial status, legally protected medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other status or classification protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. THL is committed to the importance of non-discriminatory practices within the nonprofit sector, as well as all workplace environments, and strongly encourages all interested candidates to apply.

Accommodations

The Humane League is committed to fully supporting all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, THL provides reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws throughout the hiring process and employment if hired. If a reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact the People team at accommodations@thehumaneleague.org to initiate the interactive process. THL complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, and all other applicable state and local laws.

AI Policy

Original work and thought are essential in the hiring process and allow us to evaluate you based on your own skills and competency. Therefore, the use of artificial intelligence (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Rytr, Google Assistant, etc) to generate responses is strictly prohibited. By submitting this application you agree to comply with our AI Policy. Violations of this policy in any part of the recruitment process will result in being dismissed from consideration. If you need a reasonable accommodation to this policy, please see above for more information.

jobs.description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need loads more people to help us make our vision a reality.

This could not be a better time to join Octopus Energy. We are already recognised as a global leader in the fight to decarbonise the planet by revolutionising what’s possible in energy - including investments in renewable energy supply, renewable energy generation, smart energy networks, EVs, heat pumps, etc. The government's new green initiatives and the recent investment by Al Gore’s Generation Fund will propel us further and faster.
We’re taking Tenant Power to the next level. We’ve moved past the early trial phase and are ready to scale things up.
Your mission in this role is to make sure our installations are consistent, super straightforward for installers, and transition smoothly from "ready to go" to fully live and running.
This is a hands-on, field-based role. You won’t be chained to a desk. Instead, you’ll spend plenty of time out on-site working alongside housing associations, third-party installers, suppliers, and our internal teams.
You’ll get to see how things actually work in the real world, help teams get it "right first time," and bring back practical site feedback to help us build better guides, training, and future plans.
Your main goal is keeping things running like clockwork. You’ll support our installers by helping them get a clear grip on:
The Blueprint: The approved Tenant Power design and kit requirements.
The Process: The installation sequence and what we need to see to sign it off.
The Finish Line: What’s required to get the data flowing and officially go live.
Just to keep things clear on who does what:
The Installers: They are independent contractors, usually chosen and hired directly by the housing association or delivery partner.
Octopus: We support the model by setting the technical standards, design rules, and go-live conditions.
The Responsibility: While we are there to guide them, the installers and the partners who hired them are still responsible for the actual site safety, compliance, workmanship, and final certifications.

1. Hands-on on-site support

-
Get stuck in on-site: You’ll work side-by-side with installers during their first setups, live installs, and any troubleshooting runs. You'll help them master the Tenant Power design, meter setups, and what's needed for sign-off.

-
Bridge the gap: You'll collaborate with the OE Homes Delivery team to make sure our guides are actually useful on a busy site. This means making sure instructions for kit setups, battery/inverter wiring, meter placement, and data monitoring are crystal clear.

-
Set teams up for success: Before a single tool is lifted, you'll help make sure the installers truly understand the technical requirements, approved kit lists, and platform guides so there are no surprises midway through.

2. Learning, improving, and scaling

-
Spot what works (and what doesn't): You'll keep an eye out for what makes an install breeze through, as well as the hiccups that cause delays, missing data, or "installed-but-not-yet-live" limbo. You'll use these insights to help us build a smoother, repeatable process.

-
Be the feedback loop: Keep track of common installer questions, repeating issues, or confusing instructions. You’ll feed this real-world feedback straight back to our design, training, and standards teams so we can keep improving.

-
Pick the right battles: Use your on-site knowledge to help prioritize which properties or batches are genuinely ready to go, ensuring we focus on the projects most likely to transition smoothly to live operation.

3. Collaboration and alignment

-
Empower our installers: Since they are independent contractors, your job is to coach them on our standards and design intent. You'll help them confidently deliver high-quality work that matches our blueprint every time.

-
Bring everyone together: You'll act as the connector between housing associations, installers, supply chain, data, and delivery teams, helping to smooth out any friction points in the journey from "installed" to "live."

storage installations and necessary qualifications

jobs.title: Energy Specialist
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.
In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.
Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.
È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.
Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.

⚡ Renderai l’energia più semplice. Aiuterai i clienti a capire bollette, contatori, tariffe e pratiche senza usare parole incomprensibili e senza complicazioni.

💡 Troverai soluzioni concrete. Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.

📞 Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine. Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e-mail e su WhatsApp.

🧠 Ragionerai con la tua testa. Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.

❤️ Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna. Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.

🌍 Farai la differenza. Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più sostenibili, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

-
Ti piace aiutare le persone, davvero: ti dà soddisfazione capire un’esigenza, sciogliere un dubbio e risolvere un problema.

-
Sai ascoltare e comunicare in modo semplice, diretto e umano, anche quando devi spiegare temi complessi o gestire situazioni delicate.

-
Non devi conoscere già il settore energetico: conta di più la voglia di imparare, capire i problemi e trovare soluzioni.

-
Prendi iniziativa, non ti fermi alla prima difficoltà e ti piace seguire un caso dall’inizio alla fine.

-
Ti riconosci in un modo di lavorare che mette insieme tecnologia, responsabilità personale e lavoro di squadra.

-
In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati

-
Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

-
Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

-
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

-
Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

-
Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

-
Sede: Ancarano/Ascoli Piceno

-
Disponibilità: immediata

-
Ore: Tempo pieno

OEGen is a specialist energy investment manager overseeing more than £8 billion of assets under management. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a net zero energy system by investing in clean energy infrastructure and energy transition businesses across multiple jurisdictions.
As our international portfolio continues to grow, we are looking to strengthen our in-house tax capability with the addition of a commercially minded tax professional who is keen to develop within a fast-paced investment environment.

We are looking for a Tax Assistant Manager / emerging Tax Manager to join the OEGen Tax Team, reporting directly to the Funds & Deals Tax Lead. The successful candidate will join the tax function at Sky Generation, the UK clean energy infrastructure platform of the Sky Fund, which owns and manages a number of international operating platforms. These businesses are active across Europe and beyond, developing, investing in and managing renewable energy and broader energy transition assets.
This is a strong opportunity for someone with around 4–5 years’ experience who is looking to step into a broader international role and continue developing their technical, commercial and project management capabilities within a growing infrastructure investment environment.

The role will support the Sky Fund’s portfolio and associated holding structures across multiple jurisdictions. You will work closely with investment teams, finance teams, portfolio companies and external advisers on a broad range of tax matters, including tax compliance oversight, reporting, transactions, structuring and ongoing portfolio support.
The position offers wide exposure to international investment structures, cross-border transactions and the full lifecycle of infrastructure investments, while working within a collaborative, hands-on and growing in-house tax team.

- Support the management of tax matters across OEGen funds and associated holding structures.

- Coordinate international tax compliance processes with local advisors across multiple jurisdictions.

- Assist with tax reporting, tax provisioning, and financial statement disclosures.

- Support tax workstreams on acquisitions, restructurings, refinancings, and other transactions.

- Review transaction and financing documentation from a tax perspective, with support from senior team members where needed.

- Monitor tax risks and support ongoing governance and compliance processes.

- Work closely with investment, finance, legal, and external advisory teams across the business.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal tax processes and documentation.

- Around 4–5 years’ experience in corporate tax.

- CTA, ACA, or equivalent qualification (or close to qualification).

- Experience gained in a Big 4 firm, international advisory firm, law firm, or in-house tax team.

- Good grounding in tax compliance, reporting, and tax accounting.

- Exposure to cross-border structures or international tax matters is helpful, but deep expertise is not expected.

- An interest in infrastructure, energy, or investment management is a plus.

- Foreign language skills (particularly German, French, Spanish, or Italian) would be beneficial but are not required.

Datenschutz ist für uns kein reines Compliance-Thema. Er ist ein zentraler Bestandteil von gutem Kundenservice. - Mehrjährige praktische Datenschutz Erfahrung im Customer Service Umfeld, idealerweise in einem Wachstumsunternehmen oder Scale-up.

- Erfahrung in der operativen Umsetzung von Datenschutzanforderungen in kunden- und datenintensiven Prozessen.

- Fähigkeit, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen verständlich und praxisnah zu übersetzen.

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Technologiepartnern und Softwareentwicklungsteams.

- Pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Fokus auf Umsetzbarkeit.

- Hohe Eigenständigkeit und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

- Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen.

- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

- Klare, verständliche Kommunikation ohne unnötige Komplexität.

- Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Hands-on-Mentalität.

- Bereitschaft, Dinge aktiv mitzugestalten.

- Freude an einem Umfeld mit hoher Veränderungsgeschwindigkeit.

In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.
Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.
È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.
Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.
 

⚡ Renderai l’energia più semplice. Aiuterai i clienti a capire bollette, contatori, tariffe e pratiche senza usare parole incomprensibili e senza complicazioni.

💡 Troverai soluzioni concrete. Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.

📞 Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine. Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e-mail e su WhatsApp.

🧠 Ragionerai con la tua testa. Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.

❤️ Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna. Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.

🌍 Farai la differenza. Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più sostenibili, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

-
Ti piace aiutare le persone, davvero: ti dà soddisfazione capire un’esigenza, sciogliere un dubbio e risolvere un problema.

-
Sai ascoltare e comunicare in modo semplice, diretto e umano, anche quando devi spiegare temi complessi o gestire situazioni delicate.

-
Non devi conoscere già il settore energetico: conta di più la voglia di imparare, capire i problemi e trovare soluzioni.

-
Prendi iniziativa, non ti fermi alla prima difficoltà e ti piace seguire un caso dall’inizio alla fine.

-
Ti riconosci in un modo di lavorare che mette insieme tecnologia, responsabilità personale e lavoro di squadra.

-
In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati

-
Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ?
Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France.
Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien.
Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops, capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler, mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe.
Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle :
du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process
du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données
Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.

1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
simplifier et améliorer nos process

-
construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

-
construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

-
automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

-
identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

-
participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

-
accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

-
l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

-
la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

-
le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

-
les questions des managers et des salarié·es

-
le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

-
le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

-
tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

-
tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

-
tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

-
tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel et, plus largement, avec un environnement de travail digital : Google Workspace, Slack, MacBook…

-
tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

-
tu es autonome, à l’aise dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et capable de prioriser entre projets de fond et sujets opérationnels plus urgents

Pour être transparent, ce poste ne correspondra probablement pas à quelqu’un qui cherche :

-
un poste de Data Analyst / People Analyst pur

-
un rôle uniquement centré sur les projets, sans envie de contribuer au run

-
un poste principalement orienté paie ou administration du personnel

-
un poste purement tech

-
un rôle très stratégique ou de management, éloigné du quotidien des opérations

Nous cherchons quelqu’un de polyvalent et solide en People Ops, qui peut aussi bien passer une matinée à faire avancer un projet outil ou data qu’une après-midi à aider l’équipe sur de la paie, une incohérence de données ou une question manager.

Welcome to the future of energy

Octopus is a tech-powered energy company. We believe technology has the power to address our greatest challenge, climate change, while also delivering incredible service and customer experience.

We are changing the way people interact with their energy company - by making it approachable, low cost, easy-to-understand, and most importantly, 100% renewable.

Want to work in a soul-destroying customer service call center?
Don’t apply here.
 
We’re a bit different...
You won’t believe it until you actually start working here. We try to explain it during the application and interview process but really, until you’re immersed in our culture, you’ll realize you’ve never worked anywhere like it. 
 
At Octopus you’re not a number. You're a human and we treat you like one. And that’s how we want our customers to feel too. We want you to help our customers - like genuinely help. Like out of the box, what can I do here to make a difference to this customer, help? Crazy huh?
 
You’ll chat to customers over the phone and via email while being given the freedom to help them in a way you too would like to be helped. You’ll take ownership of their needs and find a way, no matter what, to figure things out with them.
 
We treat all of our customers like our grannies, (No offense intended - we really love our grannies) - with patience, kindness and warmth. We could tell you so many stories of the relationships customers have built with us as if we were family. Would you believe they send us poems, artwork, handwritten letters, photos of their family, babies and pets? It’s bonkers and we love it. 
 
We call it the Octopus effect.
It won't take long for those tentacles to wrap around your heart once you join us. Your colleagues will be some of the most amazing people you’ll be lucky enough to call friends. They are the most enthusiastic, determined, curious crew who love being part of disrupting the energy industry but also sharing our mission to humanize the customer service experience. 
 
We don’t lie - it’s not easy.
Learning in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment isn’t for the faint-hearted. Every day you will come across problems not seen before, and you’ll be tasked with bringing about awesome solutions. Expect the unexpected. Ask questions, drive change ,and share your ideas.
 
There’s a lot (and we mean a lot) to learn, and a lot of work to do. Just when you think you know everything there is to know - something changes. We’ll help you build your knowledge and be committed to your development. If you’ve got the attitude to thrive here and want to make a difference - we’ll go that extra mile for you.

- Talk to our customers over the phone or via email, resolving their queries and perhaps engaging with other suppliers too.

- Working in Operations, you’ll be at the heart of everything we do - helping our customers.

- Taking full responsibility for all issues that you come across, you’ll be delivering end to end customer service. Gone are the days of customers getting stuck in a never ending loop of being transferred between departments, you’ll be fully trained in every aspect of the customer experience and be able to help with any problem.

- Every day, you’ll be tasked with bringing about awesome solutions while keeping up with rapid fire change as we grow. Expect the unexpected.

- Open minded - We’re a rapidly growing company, which means sometimes things go wrong, and we don’t shy away from this. We take everything as a learning curve and expect you to as well, being proactive in spotting weak areas and suggesting solutions and improvements to the customer’s experience.

- Approachable - Everything we do in operations, and across Octopus, is built around teamwork. People in our teams are always there to support and help each other and we expect everyone to be a team player.

- Inclusive - We are looking to continue building our wonderful, inclusive culture full of enthusiastic, unique and diverse people from all backgrounds as we grow and continue to change the industry.

- Dedicated to sustainability - As a renewable energy supplier, those who are a part of our team are also deeply committed to helping in any way they can in their own lives in the fight against climate change and making a positive impact for the future.

- Committed to improvement - Our energy specialists are the main point of call for our customers and their input hugely shapes the customer journey. We are looking for people who will actively looking for ways in which we can improve the customer experience and not be afraid to speak up.

jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.

Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.

- Gestire comunicazioni e richieste tramite sistemi dedicati e garantire un servizio rapido ed efficiente.

- Monitorare le normative di settore e applicare le best practices per una gestione conforme e trasparente.

- Esperienza pregressa in un ruolo simile, preferibilmente nel settore energetico o finanziario.

- Capacità di analisi e attenzione ai dettagli, con un approccio orientato alla soluzione.

- Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali per interagire con clienti e colleghi.

- Attitudine al lavoro in un ambiente dinamico, con capacità di gestire priorità e scadenze.

- Conoscenza delle normative relative al credito e capacità di mantenersi aggiornato sulle evoluzioni del settore.

- Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza. Lavoriamo con autonomia e fiducia, crediamo che l’impegno vada riconosciuto con benefici che contano davvero per chi lavora con noi.

jobs.description:
宇宙に「緑」の大穴をあけるために、力を貸してください！ 世界中で再生可能エネルギー革命を推進するミッションを実現するため、より多くの人の協力が必要なのです。

＜ご応募の際は日本語の職務経歴書をご提出ください＞

年次有給休暇23日／東京ガスと英国オクトパスエナジーの合弁会社

わたしたちは「グリーンな電力」をお手頃価格で提供地球に優しいグリーンな電力を手頃な価格で提供する会社です。
近年世界中で注目の「再生可能エネルギー」を日本にも普及させるため、2021年に東京ガスと電力会社オクトパスエナジーが共同出資して誕生しました。

＜わたしたちはこういう会社です＞
・出社と同時に自分の個性を包み隠さなくてはならないような職場ではなく、本来の自分でいられるような会社にしたい。なぜならその人物こそが我々が採用した人であり、ありのままの自分で同僚とやりとりしたり、お客様の応対をしてほしいから。その人の本質を尊重し、ありのままの自分で居られて、自ら創造性を高めて仕事に大いに貢献してもらえるような会社でありたい。そのためにも、社員がインスパイアされモチベーションを高められリラックスできる空間と合わせて、世界中の方々をお迎えする空間作りを行っている。
・オクトパスの原理は、昔の建築の石垣の原理。つまり、２つと無いユニークな形の自然石同士の合わせの良さで強度を持たせて、何千年も持ち堪えることができる仕組みを大事にしている。だからこそありのままの自分を出してほしい。
・自由と責任は比例する。みなさんには自由を持って働いてほしい。ソファに体をうずめて脚を投げ出した格好で仕事をしても良いし、好きな音楽を聴きながらでもいいし、服装も完全自由。休暇の申請も妥当なタイミングで良い。出勤退勤の打刻も必要無い。就業規則は最小限の内容。ただし自由には責任が伴う。自由と適切なプレッシャーを同時に味わいながら、常に昨日の自分よりも成長してほしいし邁進してほしい。
・負荷をかけるというと、大企業では「苦手なことをさせる」場合が多いが、オクトパスでは皆が得意分野に取り組んで、オリジナリティを活かす。それこそが組織の強靭化につながる。なので、ITがやりたいならITを、営業なら営業、企画なら企画、好きなことで最大限あなたの力を活かしてほしい。そしていま私たちは、カスタマーサービスがやりたい人を探している。
・ミスは表彰する。ミスが起きたとき、ミスをミスと認めることが肝要。そしてそれを責めず、寛容さをもって受け入れる。時には表彰して茶化す(笑)。皆が皆理由があってここにいるのだから、皆で支え合うのが当たり前。

- 週休二日制です。
- オペレーション部門にて、日本のお客様をサポートするすべての業務の中心となっていただきます。
- お客様が直面するすべての問題に全責任を持ち、エンド・ツー・エンドのカスタマーサービスを提供します。
- もう、お客様が部署間をたらい回しにされるようなことはありません。
- 顧客体験のあらゆる側面について完全に訓練され、業界全体のトレーニングが提供されます。
- お客様からの問い合わせに全責任を持ち、適切な解決策を提供できるようになることが期待されます。
- 予想外のことも想定してください。
- エネルギーの経験は必要ありません。オクトパスではこれまでとは異なるやり方をしますので、必ずしも役立つとは限りません！主体性のある方を求めています。柔軟でダイナミックな機会を探している方なら学歴・年齢不問。新卒の方でも、子育て中の方でも、フレキシブルでダイナミックなお仕事をお探しの方なら大歓迎です。

- 日本のお客様へ電話サポートができるレベルの日本語力 - わたしたちは日本のお客様に日本語でサポートとサービスを提供しています。トレーニングも日本語で行われます。そのため日本語の読み書き、および会話が今現在すでに流暢な方でなければ、日本でのエナジースペシャリストの仕事は難しいです。
- カスタマーサポートへの情熱 - お客様は私たちのすべての活動の中心です。オクトパスエナジーでは、CEOからデータ・サイエンティストに至るまで、社員全員がお客様と接しています。オクトパスエナジーが、エネルギーサプライヤーとしてお客様に感動と興奮を与え続けられるために、地の果てまで赴くことがあなたの主な責任となります。
- オープンマインド - わたしたちは急成長中の企業であり、時にはうまくいかないこともあります。何事も学習曲線と捉え、積極的に弱点を発見し、解決策を提案し、顧客体験を改善することが期待されます。
- 親しみやすい - オペレーション部門はもちろん、オクトパスではチームワークを大切にしています。オクトパスでは、チームの全員が常にお互いをサポートし、助け合い、チームプレーヤーであることが期待されます。
- インクルーシブ（排他的じゃない） - オクトパスが成長し、業界を変革し続けるために、わたしたちの組織はあらゆるバックグラウンドを持つ、熱意と個性にあふれた多様な人材で構成されています。そして素晴らしいインクルーシブな企業文化を築き続けたいと考えています。排他的な考えをしがちな人には不向きな仕事です。
- 持続可能性への献身 - 再生可能エネルギーを供給する立場として、気候変動との闘いにおいて自分自身の生活の中でできる限りの支援をし、未来に良い影響を与えることに深くコミットしていただきます。
- 改善へのコミットメント - 今回募集するエナジースペシャリストという仕事はお客様との主な窓口であり、エナジー・スペシャリストの意見や提案は顧客体験に大きな影響を与えています。ですので、顧客体験を改善する方法を積極的に探し、発言することを恐れない人材を求めています。
- 仕事に対する強い倫理観 - オペレーションの仕事は非常にペースが速く、時には困難なこともあります。言い訳したくなる事もあるでしょう。しかしわたしたちは、困難な状況に対処して目標達成のために懸命に努力することで、自分の将来に責任を持てる人材を求めています。取得した経験やスキルや仲間からの信頼は、すべてあなた個人の財産です。

- 勤務地：東京都港区六本木１−４−５アークヒルズサウスタワー１８階
- 交通：東京メトロ南北線「六本木一丁目駅」より徒歩１分
- 勤務時間：フレックスタイム制（標準労働7.5時間）＊9:00-17:00は電話対応がある時間帯なのでこの時間帯に従事できることを期待されます。残業は月平均10〜20時間
- 年間休日：121日
- 週休2日制。六本木のオフィスへ出勤していただきます。
- 年末年始休暇
- 年次有給休暇は入社初日から23日間付与します
- 産休・育休
- 介護休暇
- 慶弔休暇
- 上司判断による追加の有給休暇もあります

jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join us as Social Media Manager Italy to define and execute Qonto's social media strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube for the Italian market. You'll drive brand awareness, engagement, and customer acquisition through culturally resonant content, influencer collaborations, and data-driven campaigns. You will report to Marta Rifà Llimós, Head of Southern Europe Marketing.
➡️ What you'll do
Own the social strategy for Italy: Define the channel mix, content types (entertainment, product, educational, corporate), and calendar across IG, LinkedIn, and YouTube — with full autonomy.
Build and run the content calendar: Coordinate the monthly publishing plan across Design, Press, Events, PMM, Community, and external agencies. You ensure on-time delivery and strategic coherence.
Create content hands-on: Shoot and edit video/photo content using CapCut, Edits, Figma, or similar tools. Be comfortable on camera — you bring Qonto's Italian brand to life through owned content.
Run paid social campaigns: Manage LinkedIn campaigns directly, coordinate Instagram paid with our Italian agency, and support YouTube Ads with the media team.
Track performance and evolve strategy: Extract KPIs, draw conclusions, and systematically apply learnings. You use data to evolve your approach, not just report on it.
➡️ What we're looking for
3 years as the in-house social media owner for an Italian brand — not agency-side. You've designed and executed the full channel strategy across IG, LinkedIn, and YouTube solo, without an account manager or team below you. B2B or scale-up experience strongly preferred
Italian copywriting excellence: sharp, error-free, culturally resonant. You localise, not translate. Perfect written and oral Italian and English.
Data fluency: You work with Sprout, Google Analytics, Looker Studio (or equivalents) and you can walk through a campaign's performance metric by metric and tell me what you changed as a result — not just that results were positive
Influencer management: You've run creator campaigns end-to-end — sourcing, briefing, negotiation, performance tracking. You've owned the full cycle.
Paid social experience: You've managed LinkedIn campaigns and can brief an agency on Instagram paid with clear objectives and creative direction.
➡️ What we can offer you
Full ownership of a market: You define Italy's social strategy and you execute it. No committee approvals — you own the output and the results.
A growing content playground: Podcast, influencer collaborations, events coverage, video production — the formats are expanding and you'll shape what comes next.
Cross-functional collaboration across Southern Europe: You'll work daily with Design, Press, Events, PMM, Community, and Qonto's global social media team. Marta's team covers Italy, Spain, and Portugal — three markets, shared learnings.
AI-first environment: Daily experimentation with AI tools is expected. You'll have access to the best tools on the market to evolve your craft.
➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Marta Rifà Llimós, Head of Marketing Southern Europe, based in Barcelona.
Her path? 10+ years in digital marketing across Southern European markets. Marta spent 5+ years at Engel & Völkers growing from Digital Marketing Assistant to Marketing Manager Iberia, then led EU performance and cross-channel marketing at Birchbox. She joined Qonto in 2022 as Marketing Lead Spain, built the market from the ground up, and was promoted to Head of Marketing Southern Europe in 2025 — now leading Italy, Spain, and Portugal.
What does she bring to the team? A hands-on, data-driven leadership style with deep multi-market experience. She's built marketing operations from scratch and knows what it takes to grow a market. She runs a flat team where ideas are welcomed and ownership is expected.
